messages.content: Build an asset gallery that displays images, icons, fonts, audio, video, and data files placed in an app assets folder, and show where each asset is served on web and mobile.
Build a small authentication app with registration, login, logout, and a protected dashboard, using separate public and signed-in pages.
Build a messaging demo where I can trigger welcome, receipt, and alert emails plus in-app notifications, and inspect the send history.
Create a real-time messaging demo that shows public, private, and presence-based updates, including the current participant list.
Build an admin dashboard for testing a full resource workflow: create, view, edit, and delete records, with validation and clear status feedback.
Create a diagnostic app with custom not-found and error screens, plus controls that trigger common API errors and show user-friendly toast messages.

Create an event-processing dashboard where I can trigger events, inspect listener activity, and follow each event through its processing history.
Build a job queue demo where I can dispatch background jobs, compare sync and queued execution, and inspect completed and failed job results.
Build a layout showcase that demonstrates nested shells, panels, and modals alongside guest-only and authenticated pages on web and mobile.
Create an email testing dashboard where I can send sample messages, configure recipients and content, and review delivery attempts.
Build a middleware demo with a protected API route that validates incoming JSON requests and a screen for testing successful and rejected requests.
Create a multi-page showcase that demonstrates reusable components, separated page sections, and consistent custom styling across the app.
Build a notification center that demonstrates database, email, and real-time notifications, with controls to trigger each type and review recent activity.
Create a role-based dashboard with separate admin and user access, protected routes, and controls that demonstrate which actions each role is allowed to perform.
Build a scheduler dashboard where I can run sample scheduled commands, inspect their configuration, and review execution history.
